title: Guinea Powers China's Aluminium Record - But a Cap Looms
section_path: Guinea Powers China's Aluminium Record - But a Cap Looms
section_path_text: Guinea Powers China's Aluminium Record - But a Cap Looms
summary:
Main
By Ulf Bergman
According to data released by the Chinese National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) a few days ago, aluminium output reached a new monthly record in August. The Chinese smelters hiked production by 4.7 per cent compared with the same month last year, producing 3.98 million tonnes. Last month's reading was marginally higher than the previous monthly high, set in June this year, highlighting that the current run of high profit margins is driving producers to maximise output.

children.section_path_text: Robust Chinese Seaborne Trade in Bauxite
children.summary: Like Chinese aluminium output, bauxite exports bound for China have enjoyed a strong year. With only May bucking the trend, monthly shipments have been higher than during the same period last year.

children.title: Outlook for the Chinese Bauxite and Aluminium Trade
section_path: Outlook for the Chinese Bauxite and Aluminium Trade
children.section_path_text: Outlook for the Chinese Bauxite and Aluminium Trade
children.summary: The solid cargo volumes for bauxite heading for China during the past month could suggest that the country's aluminium production will remain high in the coming months. However, enforcement of the production cap would see a pullback in Chinese aluminium production during the remainder of the year.
